import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { area } from "./area";
import { artistCreditName } from "./artist_credit_name";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "sort_name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const artist = defineTable("artist", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        gid: col.uuid().notNull(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        sortName: col.text().notNull(),
        beginDateYear: col.smallint(),
        beginDateMonth: col.smallint(),
        beginDateDay: col.smallint(),
        endDateYear: col.smallint(),
        endDateMonth: col.smallint(),
        endDateDay: col.smallint(),
        type: col.integer(),
        area: col.integer(),
        gender: col.integer(),
        comment: col.varchar().notNull().default(""),
        editsPending: col.integer().notNull().default(0).validate({ min: 0 }),
        lastUpdated: col.timestamptz().onCreateNow(),
        ended: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        beginArea: col.integer(),
        endArea: col.integer()
    },
    relations: {
        areaRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => area, { localKey: "area", onDelete: "no action" }),
        beginAreaRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => area, { localKey: "begin_area", onDelete: "no action" }),
        endAreaRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => area, { localKey: "end_area", onDelete: "no action" }),
        artist_credit_name: rel.hasMany(() => artistCreditName, { foreignKey: "artist" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
